rows.title: Novel pharmacotherapies for opioid use disorder and opioid withdrawal.
rows.evidence_boundary: This is a narrative review of emerging OUD and withdrawal pharmacotherapies; promising mechanisms and early signals are not equivalent to established treatment efficacy or guideline endorsement.

rows.title: Pharmacokinetics, Safety, and Dosing of Antiseizure Medications in Patients with Renal or Hepatic Impairment.
rows.evidence_boundary: Cannabidiol is discussed as one antiseizure medication within organ-impairment dosing guidance; conclusions are drug- and disease-specific and should not be generalized to nonprescription CBD use.

rows.title: Effects of Δ(9)-tetrahydrocannabinol on affiliative social behaviour: A systematic review of rodent studies.
rows.evidence_boundary: The evidence base is entirely rodent/preclinical; social-behavior findings cannot be assumed to predict human psychosocial effects.

rows.title: Pharmacokinetics of Buccally Administered Cannabidiol and Oral Carprofen During Single- and Repeated-Dose Administration in Dogs.
rows.evidence_boundary: This is a veterinary dog pharmacokinetic study; it may inform interaction hypotheses but cannot establish human CBD pharmacokinetics, efficacy, or safety.

rows.title: Functionalized Colloidal Hydroxyapatite for Combined Delivery of Cannabidiol and Epirubicin: Characterization, Biomimetic Membrane Interaction, and Cytotoxicity Studies.
rows.evidence_boundary: The work is a biomaterials/cell-cytotoxicity study of CBD co-delivery with epirubicin; it is mechanistic and not evidence for oral CBD supplementation or clinical cancer efficacy.
